commit 0509313c10a4d97cfebba88d60b02e292e2cd0f5
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Mon Jul 1 16:37:31 2024 +0100
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Mon Jul 1 16:37:31 2024 +0100

    Bug 1901651 - Additional Rust automation messages to sheriffs. r=dandarnell
    
    
    The standard Taskcluster notifications have been recently expanded.
    "on-any" is deprecated and replaced with "on-resolved" and fires when a job
    ends regardless of whether it ran successfully or failed.
    "on-defined" is new and fires when a job is defined by the decision task.
    
    Now there's a notification that the automation will run, followed by
    a notification mid-way when Rust update is needed.
    
    The final notification that a Phab revision is ready remains.
    
    The "on-defined" notification will still come probably 10 minutes after the
    initial m-c push notification, but it's better than the 40 minute delay
    currently observed.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D215137

diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/tb-updatebot/vendor/__main__.py b/taskcluster/docker/tb-updatebot/vendor/__main__.py
index 332c259a3f1..ad8cb44f0cc 100755
--- a/taskcluster/docker/tb-updatebot/vendor/__main__.py
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/tb-updatebot/vendor/__main__.py
@@ -101,6 +101,9 @@ def run_check_upstream() -> bool:
         return True
     except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
         if e.returncode == 88:
+            notify(
+                f"Sheriffs: Rust changes incoming for Gecko head rev {GECKO_HEAD_REV[:12]}. Stay tuned!"
+            )
             return False
         else:
             raise
@@ -215,6 +218,7 @@ def get_conduit():
 
 
 def notify(body: str):
+    log(f"Notification: {body}")
     if OPERATING_MODE != "prod":
         log("Skipping Sheriff notification.")
         notify_user(body)
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/repo-update/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/repo-update/kind.yml
index c994f46ffda..0d4ed709b75 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/repo-update/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/repo-update/kind.yml
@@ -56,9 +56,11 @@ tasks:
         routes:
             by-level:
                 "3":
-                    - notify.matrix-room.!TWztIhgqLawNpRBZTC:mozilla.org.on-any
+                    - notify.matrix-room.!TWztIhgqLawNpRBZTC:mozilla.org.on-defined
+                    - notify.matrix-room.!TWztIhgqLawNpRBZTC:mozilla.org.on-resolved
                 default:
-                    - notify.email.{owner}.on-any
+                    - notify.email.{owner}.on-defined
+                    - notify.email.{owner}.on-resolved
         scopes:
             by-level:
                 "3":
